map.评估免疫性血小板减少症(ITP)的出血风险、免疫机制及治疗策略选择: Assesses bleeding risk, immune mechanisms and treatment strategy selection in immune thrombocytopenia (ITP)
map.多数观察，有出血倾向则治疗: Most observe, treat if bleeding tendency
map.需积极治疗，防严重出血: Active treatment to prevent severe bleeding
map.：糖皮质激素(泼尼松1mg/kg/d × 2-4周，或地塞米松40mg/d×4d: : Glucocorticoids (prednisone 1mg/kg/d × 2-4 wk, or dexamethasone 40mg/d × 4d), IVIG (emergency boost)
map.提示：ITP为排除性诊断，需排除继发性血小板减少(感染/药物/自身免疫病/骨髓衰: Note: ITP is a diagnosis of exclusion; rule out secondary thrombocytopenia (infection/drugs/autoimmune disease/bone marrow failure/hypersplenism). H. pylori eradication may raise platelets. Anti-phospholipid positivity needs APS-related thrombocytopenia assessment. Elderly patients: watch for myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS). TPO-RA is a major advance in second-line, fast-acting but needs long-term maintenance; monitor liver function and thrombosis risk. For clinical reference only.
map.血小板 15×10⁹/L + 黏膜出血 + 老年 + 无感染/药因 → 出血风险: Platelets 15×10⁹/L + mucosal bleeding + elderly + no infection/drug cause → very high bleeding risk, hospitalize, IVIG/steroids, watch for intracranial bleeding.
map.血小板 45×10⁹/L、无症状、成人 → 低风险，门诊观察，避免抗凝并教育出血: Platelets 45×10⁹/L, asymptomatic, adult → low risk, outpatient observation, avoid anticoagulants and educate on bleeding signs.
map.成人 <30×10⁹/L 或有出血/高危因素启动治疗；>30 且无症状可观察，儿: Adults <30×10⁹/L or with bleeding/high-risk factors start treatment; >30 and asymptomatic can observe, childhood new-onset often self-limited.
map.按血小板计数+出血部位（黏膜/消化道/中枢）+年龄综合；CNS 出血无论计数均急: By platelet count + bleeding site (mucosal/GI/CNS) + age; CNS bleeding is emergency regardless of count.
